name: Draft celebratory greetings for holidays and milestones
description: Users requested the generation of short, general celebratory messages, greetings, or well-wishes for specific holidays, milestones, and occasions, such as birthdays, weddings, birthdays, and various national or cultural festivals. The requests varied in tone, length, and recipient specificity, ranging from formal corporate announcements to humorous personal notes, but consistently focused on standard celebratory sentiments rather than romantic intimacy or expressions of gratitude and condolence.
